end_to_end.expected: Play 2 hands, Home; New game, 9 players, Start game -> modal 'End your paused session?' with 'Cash · 6 players · $4/$8 · 2 hands · paused' and 'Its Session Report will be saved.', Cancel focused; Cancel/Escape keep values and storage; End session and start -> 9-player Table; old session ended with a report; reload shows no Resume for the old session; exactly one unended session after the new game's first hand.
end_to_end.actual: Dialog text exactly as specified on both engines (screenshot: red primary confirm, outline Cancel focused, backdrop). Cancel kept players=9 and storage byte-identical; Escape (opened via Enter on Start game) closed it, focus back on Start game, values kept. Tab+Enter on End session and start opened 'Cash · 9 players · $10/$20 · Hand #1'. Old session endedAt set, one report (handsPlayed 2, endedAt equal). After hand 1 exactly one unended session (the new one). Reload: Resume shows only the new 9-player session. No console errors. 0-hand paused session (real flow: Start then Home) shows 'It has no completed hands, so no report is saved.' and Confirm deletes it with no report. No paused session (fresh and after Leave table) -> no dialog.

items.evidence: e2e new-game-confirm 'Start game with a paused session asks first and starts nothing' passes on Chromium and WebKit; test asserts dialog name, p texts, button list, Cancel focus, :modal, no header after runFor(2000), storedSessions toEqual [A], reports [], axe and same-origin. Holdout (real played session): dialog copy exact, :modal, axe clean, no Table, storage unchanged -> PASS on both engines.

e2e 'Cancel and Escape keep the paused session and the chosen values' passes on both engines; loops Cancel and Escape asserting focus, 9 / $10 / $20, no Table, JSON-identical sessions, then ← Home Resume line. Holdout: Cancel click and keyboard Enter+Escape both return focus to Start game, keep 9 players and $10 / $20, storage byte-identical; Resume session and config Cancel never show the dialog or end anything -> PASS.

e2e 'Confirm ends the paused session...' passes; asserts header 'Cash · 9 players · $4/$8 · Hand #1', A.endedAt string, one report with handsPlayed 4 and equal endedAt, a second 0-hand unended session. Holdout real flow: 9-player $10/$20 Table opens, old session endedAt >= clock now, report handsPlayed 2 with equal endedAt -> PASS.

vitest end-paused 'ends the confirmed session now...' passes; checks worked example exactly (A endedAt NOW, B deleted, C endedAt its updatedAt, D/E byte-identical, reports [A,C], pausedSession null with 1 rejected, relaunched getReport). Holdout: 6 sessions with confirmed 0-hand -> report null, others ended at their updatedAt with correct handsPlayed, second run is a no-op; seeded browser case with 2 older sessions + 0-hand + ended + invalid behaves per A-1 -> PASS.

vitest 'a failure ending the confirmed session changes nothing' passes (ConstraintError DOMException, sessions and reports byte-identical; absent id -> {null, []} and C ended). Holdout: confirmed record invalid -> RangeError, nothing changed; empty DB absent id -> {null, []}; in the browser an existing report for the paused session -> dialog closes, no Table, Game Config keeps 4 players, storage unchanged, 'Paused session could not be ended' logged -> PASS.

vitest 'a failure ending an older session...' passes (rejected length 1 ConstraintError, A and F ended, C byte-identical). Holdout browser: older session with a pre-existing report -> Table still opens, paused session ended, older one left unended, 'Session could not be ended' logged -> PASS.

vitest end-session-dialog 'renders the dialog only with a prompt' passes; asserts one <dialog with aria-labelledby, h2, all p copy, button order, no disabled vs disabled="" while ending, 0-hand line, and no <dialog without/with null prompt. Holdout seeded A(3 hands, latest), B(0), two older with hands, an ended D with report, an invalid newer E: dialog shows A; after hand 1 exactly one valid unended session (the new one), B absent, older ones endedAt == updatedAt with reports, D and E byte-identical, reports = [A, older x2, D]; Home then resumes the new session -> PASS.

e2e 'a 0-hand paused session is discarded on Confirm' passes. Holdout real 0-hand session (Start then Home): summary '... 0 hands · paused', no-report line, Confirm -> Hand #1, old id absent, reports [] -> PASS.

e2e 'with no paused session Start game starts at once' passes (fresh contexts, empty and ended-only). Holdout: fresh storage and after Leave table -> Report -> Back to Home, no dialog at click and after header, ended session and reports unchanged; double-click Start game with nothing paused creates exactly one session; double-click Start then Confirm with a paused session -> one dialog, one new session, one report -> PASS.

findings.expected_vs_actual: After a failure ending the confirmed paused session (A-5), the dialog closes and Game Config stays, but keyboard focus falls to the document body (observed on Chromium and WebKit) instead of returning to Start game as it does after Cancel/Escape (A-2). The spec does not state focus for this path, so this is not a spec violation.
findings.fix: On the A-5 failure path, return focus to Start game as for Cancel.

summary: All 11 SPEC items PASS with independent holdout checks on Chromium and WebKit (18/18 browser checks, 3/3 store checks) and an end-to-end dev-server run of the spec's Run command. Older unended sessions are ended per A-1, failures follow A-5, and exactly one session is unended after the new game. The locked next-hand.spec.ts edit is authorised and assertion-neutral. One LOW finding (focus after an A-5 failure). No blocking findings.
